sub_problems.fills: a Linux launcher that holds no dispatch of its own and execs bin/cairn.py once
sub_problems.what: replace bin/cairn's bash dispatch block with a single exec of the venv python on bin/cairn.py "$@"
sub_problems.why: Outline 5.4.3.8: after the floor the launcher execs the venv python on bin/cairn.py so one dispatcher serves both platforms; the bash copy is a second dispatcher that drifts.
